review: DAENEM Staff Portal Staff directory company-boundary review

findings.summary: Directory authority from one assigned company could be reused to read employee or role metadata from another assigned company, and a manage permission could bypass assignment on an explicit company request.
findings.correction: Employee and role directory access now evaluates every qualifying permission against the target company, filters unscoped results to authorized assigned companies, removes the cross-company manage bypass, and returns empty collections when no company is authorized.

reviewer.result: PASS for the bounded Staff directory authorization change; broader Staff and Printing functional scenario coverage remains partial, and authenticated V45 browser acceptance remains pending.
